# InPlace — Architecture

**Generated by `scripts/gen-architecture.js`. Sections marked ⚙ are rewritten by that script —
do not hand-edit them.** CI runs `npm run gen:architecture -- --check` and fails if this file
disagrees with the code, so a new route, poller or socket event that is missing here turns the
build red.

Hand-written sections (§3 "Where is…") are preserved across regeneration; edit those freely.

Structure at last generation: 569 HTTP routes across 59 mounts ·
109 `CREATE TABLE` statements · 14 background jobs · 39 socket events
(17 with no client listener) · 69 push event types · 60 `window.__*` globals.

---

## 1. The request path

```
public/index.html
  → /vendor/*.js (React, socket.io, leaflet — self-hosted, NOT a CDN)
  → /js-compiled/bundle.js        (built by scripts/build-client.js: Babel + terser)
     └── bundle-admin.js is lazy-loaded, admins only
  → apiFetch()  [public/js/utils.js]  — 25 s timeout, single-flight 401→refresh→retry
     → Express  [src/server.js]
        malformed-URL guard → helmet → CORS → cookie-parser → Sentry user tag
        → route-scoped express.json limits → global 100 kb → limitBodySize
        → authLimiter / apiLimiter → static → request log → verifyCsrf → auditLog
        → routers (§2)
```

**There is a build step.** `npm start` runs `scripts/build-client.js` before the server starts.
JSX is *not* compiled in the browser; Babel-standalone is not loaded. Editing anything in
`public/js/` requires a rebuild (`node scripts/build-client.js`) before it reaches a browser.

## 3. Where is…

The index that makes a bug report into one hop. Add a row whenever you spend more than two
greps finding something.

| Task | Go to |
|---|---|
| The check-in gate (why a button is disabled) | `src/constants/checkIn.js` is the intended single owner. Today the 15-minute rule is duplicated in `src/routes/sessions.js`, `public/js/components/CaretakerHub.js` (×2) and `CaregiverCalendar.js` — the button itself is gated by `readyToCheckIn` in CaretakerHub |
| Cancellation and the cancellation fee | `src/routes/sessions.js` `/:id/cancel`, `/:id/cancel-preview`; fee math in `src/utils/cancellationFee.js` |
| Sending a push | `src/routes/push.js` → `sendPushToUser(userId, payload, eventType)`. **This file is a library, required by ~23 others.** `src/utils/push.js` is a legacy adapter with a different signature — do not use it for new code |
| Authorization ("can this user touch this row?") | `src/utils/access.js` → `sessionAccess()`, `recipientAccess()`. Failed checks answer **404, not 403** |
| Pay calculation | server-side only, `src/utils/rateCalculator.js`; check-in→check-out in 15-minute blocks |
| The identity gate | `src/utils/identityDecision.js`. **The AI never writes `approved`; only an admin does** |
| Session status machine | `validTransitions` in `src/routes/sessions.js` |
| Reimbursement approve | `src/routes/reimbursements.js` `/:id/approve` — writes the row, then `audit()`, `feedEntry()`, `notifyParties()` |
| "Am I production?" | `src/utils/env.js` — the only place that decides. Never gate on `NODE_ENV`; Railway does not set it |
| Timezone conversion | `src/utils/timezone.js` server, `TimezoneHelper.js` client. All times are **care-location** times |
| Blob storage | `src/utils/storage.js` → `storeFileData()`, `resolveFileData()`. R2-backed, `r2:<key>` markers, legacy base64 rows still readable |
| Who may see a medical record / who holds the iPAi key | `src/utils/medicalAccess.js` → `medicalRole()`, `canViewMedical()`, `canManageMedicalAccess()`, `aiKeyHolder()`. Never `canAccessOwner` in documents.js |
| Passkey step-up for medical records | `src/utils/medicalStepUp.js` (challenge/verify, 10-min window in `medical_step_ups`) |
| Is a care recipient's linked "own account" really her? | `src/utils/linkedAccount.js` → `trustedLinkedUserId()`, `isTrustedLinkedUser()`, `recipientForLinkedUser()`, SQL `TRUSTED_LINK_SQL` / `trustedLinkSql(alias)` / `trustedLinkedIdSql(alias)`. Stale links are listed at Admin → Integrity (`GET /api/admin/integrity/linked-accounts`, unlink via `POST …/:recipientId/unlink`) |

### Medical records (Documents Center, migration `050_documents_center`)

Route map — `/api/medical-records` (`src/routes/medicalRecords.js`); upload reuses the multipart
`POST /api/documents/upload` with `category=medical`.

| Route | Gate |
|---|---|
| `GET /recipients` | sign-in; returns per-recipient flags |
| `GET /:crId` | `canView` — titles/metadata, key state, sharing list (leader/member only) |
| `POST /step-up/challenge` · `POST /step-up/verify` | passkey; no passkey → 403 `needsPasskey` ("Account → Security"), no bypass |
| `GET /:crId/docs/:docId/open[?download=1]` | `canView` + fresh step-up; refused under impersonation; audited `viewed`/`downloaded` |
| `PUT /:crId/access/:userId` | leader or member + step-up; caregivers refused |
| `PUT /:crId/ai-consent` | key holder + passkey assertion **every time**; revoke deletes pending suggestions |
| `GET /:crId/audit` | key holder, leader, member |
| `GET /:crId/suggestions` | `canView` + step-up; refused under impersonation |
| `POST /:crId/docs/:docId/review` | `canView` + key ON + `acknowledged:true` (recorded in `medical_ai_acks`) + step-up |
| `POST /:crId/suggestions/:id/decide` | `canView`; appointment accept → `care_events` row (needs schedule permission or member); medication/review item accept → marked reviewed only |

Data rules:

- Medical records are `verified_documents` rows with `category='medical'`, `owner_type='care_recipient'`,
  `status='stored'`. **Stored, not verified**: never in `/api/documents/admin/pending`/`count`, never
  sent to `documentAI`, excluded from admin drawers/previews (`admin/overview.js`, `verification.js`,
  `userFlags.js`) and from the generic owner list. `/api/documents/:id/download` refuses them (403
  `MEDICAL_RECORD`) — they open only through the audited, step-up route.
- Who sees them: the member (`linked_user_id`), the leader/owner, family members in
  `medical_record_access`. **Caregivers never** (caregiver profile or role). **No admin shortcut.**
- The iPAi key (`medical_ai_consent`, default OFF) is held by the member if she has an account,
  otherwise the leader.
- Every upload/open/download/delete/grant/revoke/key change/AI read → `medical_record_audit`.
- iPAi review (`src/utils/medicalDocAI.js`) returns only items it can quote verbatim from the one
  document; no outside knowledge, no inference, no dosing. Suggestions are never fed to another AI
  prompt and nothing is created without a human tap.
| Legal & money readiness (family checklist, "Get help nearby", money-safety concerns) | `src/routes/legalReadiness.js`, migration `051_legal_readiness` (tables `legal_readiness_answers`, `local_resources`, `financial_concerns`). Family routes at `/api/legal-readiness` (`GET /:careRecipientId`, `PUT /:careRecipientId/answers/:item`, `GET /:careRecipientId/resources`, `POST /:careRecipientId/concerns`, `POST /concerns/:id/acknowledge` → 409 if already seen). Admin routes are a second router, `adminRouter`, mounted at `/api/admin/legal-readiness` **after** `/api/admin` so the admin network gate runs first (the generator above does not count them): `GET/POST /resources`, `PUT/DELETE /resources/:id` (DELETE = hide, 409 if hidden), `GET /concerns`, `PUT /concerns/:id`, `GET /safety-flags/:flagId/recipients`, `POST /safety-flags/:flagId/share` (exploitation_signal only; 409 on a second share). **Family-only**: `familyAccess()` refuses caregivers (any `caregiver_profiles` row, unless they own the record), helpers without `read_profile`, and the care recipient's linked account. Readiness is computed from `verified_documents` (category `legal`: `POA`; `Healthcare_POA`/`Living_Will`) and an unanswered item is `unknown`, never `missing`. Client: `LegalReadinessCard.js` (Care Profile + Documents Center), `AdminLegalReadiness.js` (Admin → Local Help, and the share button on SafetyFlagsTab). Needs-you kind `financialConcern` in `src/utils/attention.js` |

## 8. Data rules

- **Schema changes go in `MIGRATIONS_V2`** (`src/models/database.js`), keyed in `schema_migrations`.
  ⚠️ The legacy `migrations` array above it is **frozen** as `000_legacy_baseline` and never replays
  on an existing database. Anything added there after v1.82.0 has never run on prod or staging.
- All times are **care-location** times. Use `getNowInZone`/`buildDateTimeInZone`; never
  `new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]`.
- Any endpoint taking base64 needs **both** a route-scoped `express.json` limit in `server.js`
  **and** a `limitBodySize` exemption in `validate.js`.
- Blobs go through `src/utils/storage.js`, never straight into a Postgres column.
- **`care_recipients.linked_user_id` is not proof of identity.** A link counts as the person only if
  that account owns the record (`family_user_id = linked_user_id`, self-signup) or is on her care team.
  Betty's profile carried a leftover self-signup link to an unrelated account (Kit Conn) that the app
  treated as Betty. Every read that treats the linked user as the care recipient — care_for views,
  dashboard, messages contacts, visit/reminder push audiences, documents, notes, blocks, reimbursements —
  goes through `src/utils/linkedAccount.js`. Writes that only CLEAR a link (account deletion) do not.

## 9. Tests and gates

```bash
npm run lint:client && npm run lint:requires && npm run lint:sql-columns && npm run lint:contrast
npm test                    # unit
npm run test:integration    # embedded PostgreSQL
npm run gen:architecture -- --check   # this file is current
```

⚠️ `npm test -- <name>` does **not** filter — the script ends in `--testPathIgnorePatterns`, so your
argument is appended to *that* and the named test is **excluded**. Use `npx jest tests/<file>`.
